class.name: GodotDoctorResourceValidationWarning
class.brief_description: A warning associated with a [Resource]. Clicking the warning opens [member origin_resource] in the inspector and navigates to it in the FileSystem dock. Used by [GodotDoctorDock] to show validation warnings related to resources.

method.name: _select_origin
method.description: Opens [member origin_resource] in the inspector and navigates to it in the FileSystem dock.

members.member: The resource that caused the warning.
